notes.title: The Boss Gangsters : Nightlife Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello bosses, first of all, we would like to express our sincere thanks for the attention you have shown. We have released an update for The Boss Gangsters: Nightlife demo based on the feedback we received from you during the Steam Next Fest.

[list]
[*]Several errors in the tutorial have been corrected.Tutorial is now more stable.
[*]Camera angles have been fixed. Now, you can play the game with a downward angle
[*]Drink sale prices have been corrected.
[*]Waiter order taking and delivery points have been rearranged
[*]The issue of remaining glasses on the table has been resolved.
[*]Now, the wholesaler where you can order drinks will refresh its inventory of available drinks every day.
[*]Building menu: To perform move and sell actions, you need to close the shop
[*]The placement of warning pop-ups has been changed, and their duration has been increased
[*]The issue of customers stacking up at the same table consecutively has been fixed.
[/list] 

If you encounter any bugs or would like to share your thoughts, you can join our Discord through the following link.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/FNfjDUKnCa]Our Discord[/url]
